cd /opt/trading-bot && sudo -u tbot venv/bin/python - <<'EOF'
import wallbot_new as w, urllib.request, json, time, sqlite3
eng = w.WallEngine(w.CFG, sqlite3.connect(":memory:"))
sym = "DOGEUSDT"
for tf in w.TF_LIST:
    kl = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines?symbol=%s&interval=%s&limit=150" % (sym, tf)))
    d = w.calc_tf([k for k in kl if k[6] < time.time()*1000])
    eng.ctx.setdefault(sym, {})[tf] = d
    print(tf, d["trend"], "pl", [round(x,5) for x in d["pl"][-3:]], "ph", [round(x,5) for x in d["ph"][-3:]])
dep = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("https://api.binance.com/api/v3/depth?symbol=%s&limit=500" % sym))
bids = [(float(a), float(b)) for a, b in dep["bids"]]; asks = [(float(a), float(b)) for a, b in dep["asks"]]
s = eng.s[sym]; s["bids_snap"], s["asks_snap"], s["snap_t"] = bids, asks, time.time()
v = eng.book_view(sym)
print("trend", v["trend"]); print("piv", [(p["tf"], p["k"], round(p["price"],5), round(p["dist"],1)) for p in v["piv"]])
print("level_ctx", eng._level_ctx(sym, bids[0][0]*0.996))
EOF
